tech.name: links present in PDF
tech.detail: 9867 link annotations for 9867 links in the source

coverage.note: Goodnotes is the first app in the title, the description ('for Goodnotes on iPad') and Start here step 1; one plain PDF (453 pages, 9867 plain GoTo named-destination links, no JavaScript or forms); Notability, Noteshelf, Samsung Notes, Xodo named on Start here and in Works with.

coverage.where: m01, m07, weeks, w01, w27, u010-u526, page_modules
coverage.note: 12 undated month pages, w01-w52 numbered with no month binding, 364 day pages u010-u526; no printed dates or year anywhere; the buyer writes dates on Weeks, week and day pages.

Checked in the PDF: 12 month tabs on every page, top bar on every page but the cover, Weeks page links w01-w52 in order, each week's 7 Open buttons go to its own Mon-Sun in position, day prev/next cross weeks (u016 -> u020), Weeks / Week N trail on every week and day page; 0 unresolved links, all pages reachable from the cover, no link box outside the page or overlapping another.

coverage.where: year, m01-m12, m01h-m12h, w01-w52, u010-u526, lists, notes-notes6
coverage.note: Year overview with 12 blank 6-row grids; month pages with Goals this month and Notes; 12 habit trackers (14 habits x 31 days); 52 week pages; 364 day pages with Top 3, To do, Time blocks, Notes, Good things today; Lists page; 6 notes pages.
Embedded fonts are only Cormorant Garamond (SemiBold, MediumItalic) and Manrope; consistent cards and spacing; month tabs run indigo to soft gold.
Start here (4 steps), Setup check page, and a 'How the links work' note on Contents, all printed in the PDF.

coverage.where: files/, listing.description How to start, photo-09-ph9.jpg, start
coverage.note: One PDF, no zip, 13.09 MB (listing says 13.1 MB); listing and photo 9 give three steps (web browser not the Etsy app, Share then Open in Goodnotes or New then Import, start); Start here step 1 repeats them, but says 'In Goodnotes, use Share' (see visual).

Cover's Open planner links to start; 4 steps (open in Goodnotes, check links, start with Week 1 with a Go there to w01, pen off/on) with a 12-month grid underneath; next page in the PDF is the Setup check with jump buttons and a pen test box; no stickers or add-on files.

coverage.where: PDF page size, listing Works with, linktest
coverage.note: Every page is 576 x 768 pt (768 x 1024 px), 3:4 portrait; listing Works with box names the five apps and says not for phones, e-ink, Files, Photos or Google Drive preview; Setup check tests links on the device.
All day pages share the same five boxes in the same places; all week pages share the same two columns; Home, Year, Lists, Notes, Weeks top bar on every page except the cover.

coverage.where: PDF link audit, weeks, w27, u182
coverage.note: Verified across all 52 weeks and 364 days: tabs, Weeks page, week to 7 days, day prev/next across Sunday to Monday, week prev/next in order w01-w52, trails present.

Every photo is a render of the built pages, captioned (Cover and a day page, Day page, Week page, Month page, Start here, Setup check, Contents, Habit tracker); description lists page types with counts and says undated, portrait only, Monday-start, no stickers, not a fillable form, English only.
Setup check has 3 buttons (m01, year, index) and a 4-line Nothing happened? list ending with an Etsy message; every link resolves and all 453 pages are reachable from the cover.

coverage.where: listing Quick answers and Help, linktest, start
coverage.note: FAQ covers the five problems (Etsy app download, which app, pen on, typing, undated weeks); Help says use Setup check then send an Etsy message; no reply time promised.

coverage.where: photo-02, photo-03, photo-04, listing Please note
coverage.note: Photos 2-4 are readable close-ups of the day, week and month pages; listing says no stickers, budget, meal or fitness sections.

Right half of each day page is time blocks and Good things today, left has Notes; each weekday has its own lined box on the week page; photo 2 shows the day page at about 2.4x its CSS size. The 1.1 text scale cannot be measured from the file, but text reads large.

Weeks page lists Week 1-52 each with a 'starts' line; Start here step 3: open Week 1, write this Monday's date, bought mid-week start on today; month grids have 6 rows (42 boxes). Early (Oct) and mid-year buyers both reach a usable page in 3 taps: Open planner, Go there, Open.
3:4 pages; week pages have Mon-Thu on the left and Fri, Sat, Sun, Notes on the right, with This week's top 3 and Next week underneath.

Jump buttons to a month, the year and Contents; pen test box; fix list; a top-bar map whose rows are also links and match their targets (Lists text says 'to read' while the page says 'To read or watch').
Hourly time blocks 6am to 9pm (16 rows) beside Top 3 and To do on every day page.
Inner pages #FBF9F4 ivory with #1E2238 ink, indigo-to-gold tabs, Cormorant headings and italic labels, Manrope body, no tracked caps; the cover is cool #ECEEF6 instead of ivory.

visual.issue: Start here step 1 and photo 9 say 'In Goodnotes, use Share, then Open in Goodnotes': Share then Open in Goodnotes happens in Safari or Files after the download, not inside Goodnotes, so a buyer may look for a Share button in Goodnotes (the listing's step 2 is worded correctly).
The Habit tracker and All weeks buttons on every month page have tap boxes only 23 pt tall in the PDF (about 31 px, 68x23 and 53x23 pt), well under a 44 px finger target, so they are easy to miss.
Top-bar pills, trails and week Open buttons are 30 pt tall (40 px), just under 44 px; day prev/next arrows are 36x31 pt (48x42 px), which is not the 'large' buttons the listing promises.
visual.where: all pages top bar, u010-u526 nav

visual.issue: The Contents 'Habit trackers' card always opens January's tracker, even for a buyer starting in another month.
In the Setup check top-bar map, Lists reads 'Three lists: to buy, to try, to read', but the page's third list is 'To read or watch'.
Photo 1 is captioned 'Cover and a day page', but the day page is almost fully hidden behind the cover; only its top bar and 'Week 1 · date' show.
In photos 3 and 7, the landscape crop fills only the middle of the frame, leaving large empty bands above and below.
Photo 4's crop ends on a thin sliver of the cut-off Notes box under Goals this month.
The cover uses a cool blue-grey #ECEEF6 rather than the warm ivory of the brief's look (inner pages are ivory).
The date blanks are small for handwriting: '_ _' in each week day box and 'date ____' in the day page eyebrow.
Week 52 still prints a 'Next week' box although the planner ends there.
